text:
maria: Quick kickoff — need a short (1-page) launch pad for enterprise prospects: a webinar (30-40m) + benchmark narrative (latency/cost vs managed) + inbound routing play. Goal: field teams hand to prospects within 48h of demo. Deliverables: pocket brief for AE, 1-slide benchmark summary, webinar script, sample routing rules. Who can own pieces?

aj: I can take the benchmark narrative. Will draft 3-case benchmark: low-latency chat, high-throughput embeddings, mixed inference with Dedicated. Need sample workloads + cost numbers. Can we get recent perf runs from eng/runtime?

sam: @aj, we have perf CSVs from last Q. I'll attach a short summary later. For the brief, call out: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, example SLAs (p50/p95 latency targets), expected $/1M tokens. Keep language non-technical for AEs.

lee: For Private deploy callouts, add KMS/HSM and audit log points. Also add a short note about fallback routing (how we degrade to smaller model). Security team prefers wording 'customer-managed keys' instead of 'bring-your-own-key'.

nina: Routing & inbound: propose 3 buckets: self-serve leads -> hosted onboarding flow; enterprise demo -> AE + Dedicated upsell; regulated -> sales + security checklist. Draft lead scoring rules here: score>80 -> notify #sales-enterprise, score 50-80 -> nurture sequence. See internal doc: https://redwood.infra/field-routing (internal)

maria: Nice. Aj — can you sketch benchmark bullets by EOD tomorrow? Nina — can you draft routing rules + sample playbook for AE handoff? Sam — short product blurb for the brief (2-3 sentences) and 3 SLA bullets? Lee — security copy for the private section? I'll compile into a 1-pager/pocket brief.

aj: On it. Will include table: workload | model | median latency | cost delta. Also add a short blurb: 'Why quantization matters for cost' :sparkles: 

sam: Product blurb draft: 'Redwood Inference delivers consistent, predictable LLM serving across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes — letting engineering teams pick the right tradeoff between latency, cost, and isolation.' SLA bullets: '99.9% uptime (hosted), p50/p95 latency targets by model tier, Dedicated capacity guarantees with committed throughput.'

lee: Security blurb draft: 'Private deployments support VPC isolation, customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logging, and SOC2-ready controls. Optional on-prem package for air-gapped environments.'

nina: I'll also add a sample automation rule (Marketo/Pardot) for routing — will paste snippet:

nina: ```
if lead.company_size > 1000 and lead.industry in ["healthcare","finance"]:
  route_to = "sales-enterprise"
elif lead.request_type == "private-deploy":
  route_to = "security-sales"
else:
  route_to = "growth-onboard"
```

maria: perfect. Once we have drafts, let's sync 30m tomorrow. Target: publish pocket brief + webinar landing page + routing playbook by next Wed. :rocket: 

launch-bot: Reminder: webinar slot confirmed 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. Registered speakers: @maria, @sam, @lee.

aj: Adding a slide: benchmark chart + one-sentence takeaway. Will ping when done.

maria: Thanks team!
